entities.name: Theodorus of Antiochia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Theodore of Antioch was a Syrian Orthodox philosopher, physician and astrologer from Antioch who served Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, as a scholar and diplomat from about 1230 until his death.
